question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Hard but liable to be easily broken
solution:
The correct answer is: **Brittle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hard but liable to be easily broken"** refers to an object that is tough yet can shatter or break easily. (कठोर लेकिन आसानी से टूटने योग्य)
 
• **​"Brittle"** describes something that is hard but can break or snap easily. (भंगुर)
 
 
• **Example: **The **brittle **nature of the old tree branch made it snap under the weight of the snow.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word is **'Brittle'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stagnant** (स्थिर): Showing no activity; dull and sluggish.

 
 
• **Example:** The **stagnant **water in the pond became a breeding ground for mosquitoes.
 
 
 
• **Fragmentary** (खंडित): Consisting of small parts that are disconnected or incomplete.
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient manuscript was found in a **fragmentary **condition, with many pages missing.
 
 
 
• **Rudiment** (मूल सिद्धांत): The first principles of a subject.
 
 
• **Example:** She learned the **rudiments **of programming before moving on to more complex topics.
